units: B. Kam. 67ᵃ (ref. to Ez. XLI, 26) העובים אלו המרישות ‘ubbim means joists.—[Y. B. Bath. V, beg. 15ᵃ והעובון, prob. to be read: והעוֹגֵין.]

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:6">Kel. XXVI, 6</cite> <he>עָב כסות</he> the bag for a garment, contrad. to <cite ref="V00557"><he>תכריך</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>עוּבִּים</he>, constr. <cite ref="P00178"><he>עוּבֵּי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>ע׳ הצמר</he> (not <he>הצור</he>) woolen material for carpet bags.
<cite ref="Chullin 49a:1">Ḥull. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ בית הכוסות</he> the pockets (folds) of &c., v. <cite ref="K00314"><he>כּוֹס</he> I</cite>.
